name: rynke-points
description: Strava integration for Team Rynkeby Hamburg: collects riders' activities (with consent), detects event participation, and awards gamified Rynke Points.
author: Sascha Steffen <sascha.steffen@itemis.de>

scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/vendor.mjs --check && node scripts/art-versions.mjs --check && node scripts/team-check.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:server: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply rynke-points --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && env -u STRAVA_CLIENT_ID -u STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET -u STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN -u TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY -u SESSION_SIGNING_KEY -u ADMIN_TOKEN -u PUSH_VAPID_KEY wrangler dev dev/worker.ts --env-file dev/fake.env --var RYNKE_FAKE_STRAVA:local-only --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --port 8797 --local-protocol https --host localhost:8797 --inspector-port 9237 --show-interactive-dev-session=false
scripts.test:e2e:server:europe: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state-europe && CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env europe --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state-europe && env -u STRAVA_CLIENT_ID -u STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET -u STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN -u TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY -u SESSION_SIGNING_KEY -u ADMIN_TOKEN -u PUSH_VAPID_KEY wrangler dev dev/worker.ts --env europe --env-file dev/fake.env --var RYNKE_FAKE_STRAVA:local-only --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state-europe --port 8798 --local-protocol https --host europe.localhost:8798 --inspector-port 9238 --show-interactive-dev-session=false
